Booking.metaDescription: Send CHEF SIS an inquiry about Ethiopian catering or a culinary experience for your event.
Booking.title: Tell us about your event
Booking.intro: Share a few details and CHEF SIS will review your request.
Booking.notBookingNote: An inquiry is not a booking. Dates and services are confirmed only after CHEF SIS has reviewed your request and agreed the details with you.
Booking.processStep1: You receive a reference number as soon as your inquiry is sent.
Booking.processStep2: CHEF SIS reviews your date, guest count and requirements.
Booking.processStep3: You are contacted by the method you chose, to agree the details.
Booking.phoneHint: Include the country code if you are outside Ethiopia, for example +251.
Booking.eventDateHint: Leave empty if you have not chosen a date yet.
Booking.venueHint: City, venue name or address, as far as you know.
Booking.requirements: What would you like CHEF SIS to provide?
Booking.requirementsHint: For example the kind of meal, style of service or any dietary needs.
Booking.consent: I agree that CHEF SIS may use these details to respond to my inquiry, as described in the <link>privacy notice</link>.
Booking.errorSummaryTitle: Please check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number (7 to 15 digits).
errors.phoneRequired: Add a phone number for this contact method.
errors.dateNotFuture: Choose a date from tomorrow onwards.
errors.dateTooFar: Choose a date within the next three years.
errors.guestMin: There must be at least 1 guest.
errors.consentRequired: Please accept to send your inquiry.

Booking.rateLimited: Too many inquiries have been sent from this connection or email address. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
Booking.captchaFailed: We could not verify that this request came from a person. Please complete the security check and try again.
Booking.conflict: This form was already sent with different details. Please reload the page to send a new inquiry.
Booking.unavailableTitle: Online inquiries are not open yet
Booking.unavailableBody: The inquiry form has not been switched on for this website yet. Please check back soon.
Booking.error: Your inquiry could not be sent and nothing was saved. Please try again in a moment.
Booking.networkError: The connection was interrupted, so we cannot tell whether your inquiry arrived. Please send it again: sending the same inquiry again will not create a duplicate.
Booking.successTitle: Thank you. Your inquiry has been received
Booking.successBody: Your inquiry is now awaiting review by CHEF SIS. This is not a booking confirmation and it does not confirm availability for your date.
Booking.referenceHint: Please keep this reference and mention it if you get in touch.
Booking.pausedBody: CHEF SIS is not taking new event inquiries at the moment. Please check back soon, or send a message from the contact page.

Privacy.metaDescription: How the CHEF SIS website handles the information you share in an event inquiry.
Privacy.draftNotice: Draft for review. This notice describes how the website currently handles inquiry information. Items marked for review must be completed by CHEF SIS, and the notice should be checked by a qualified adviser before launch. On its own it does not establish legal compliance.

AdminStaff.title: Staff & roles
AdminStaff.intro: Everyone with an admin account, and what their roles let them do. A person can hold several roles and gets everything each one allows.
AdminStaff.addStep1: The owner creates the account in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users → Add user) with the person's email address.
AdminStaff.addStep2: The new account appears in the list below with no role, so it cannot open the admin yet.
AdminStaff.addStep3: Choose “Change roles” next to the person and give them only the roles they need.
AdminStaff.withoutRoleCount: {count, plural, one {# without a role} other {# without a role}}
AdminStaff.notEditableSelf: You cannot change your own roles. Ask an owner to do it.
AdminStaff.notEditablePrivileged: Only an owner can change the roles of an owner or administrator.
AdminStaff.lockedHint: Only an owner can give or remove this role.

confirm.title: Change the roles of {name}?
confirm.privileged: Owners and administrators can change content, settings and other people's roles. Give these roles only to people you trust with the whole website.
confirm.noAccess: {name} will have no role and will no longer be able to open the admin.

errors.errorGeneric: The roles could not be saved. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change roles.
errors.errorSelf: You cannot change your own roles.
errors.errorPrivileged: Only an owner can give or remove the owner and administrator roles, or change the roles of an owner or administrator.
errors.errorLastOwner: This is the only owner. Make someone else an owner first.

AdminStaff.guideIntro: Roles are fixed: their permissions are set in the database and checked again on every page and every change.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full control of the website, including other owners and administrators, and erasing inquiries.
roleDescriptions.admin: Runs the website day to day: content, inquiries, messages, settings and other staff's roles.
roleDescriptions.content_editor: Writes, edits and publishes the website's content, images and translations.
roleDescriptions.event_manager: Works on the event inquiries assigned to them.
roleDescriptions.analyst: Sees the inquiry figures on the overview, without any customer details.

capabilities.reports: See the inquiry figures on the overview
capabilities.content: Write, edit and publish content, images and translations
capabilities.allInquiries: See, update and assign every inquiry
capabilities.assignedInquiries: See and update the inquiries assigned to them
capabilities.staff: See staff and change their roles
capabilities.privilegedStaff: Give or remove the owner and administrator roles

AdminSettings.title: Settings
AdminSettings.intro: Contact details and links shown on the public website, and the switch for new event inquiries. Changes appear on the website as soon as you save.
AdminSettings.unavailable: The settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

intros.inquiries: Pause the “Plan an event” form when CHEF SIS cannot take new events, for example during a busy season.
intros.contact: Shown on the Contact page. Leave a field empty to hide it.
intros.location: The city or area CHEF SIS serves, shown on the Contact page.
intros.social: Links to CHEF SIS's own pages, shown in the footer and on the Contact page. Leave a field empty to hide it.

hints.contact_email: Visitors can write to this address directly.
hints.contact_phone: Shown with a call link. Include the country code for callers from abroad.
hints.whatsapp_phone: The full international number, starting with + and the country code.
hints.telegram_username: With or without the @. A t.me link works too.
hints.location_en: A city or an area, not a full address.
hints.location_am: Shown on the Amharic site only after a fluent speaker's review (below). Until then the English location is shown.
hints.instagram_url: The full link to the profile, starting with https://instagram.com/
hints.facebook_url: The full link to the page, starting with https://facebook.com/
hints.tiktok_url: The full link to the profile, starting with https://tiktok.com/@
hints.youtube_url: The full link to the channel, starting with https://youtube.com/

AdminSettings.inquiriesOpenHint: On: visitors can send event inquiries.
AdminSettings.inquiriesPausedHint: Off: the form says that new inquiries are paused, and nothing can be sent. Existing inquiries are not affected.

Credits.metaDescription: Who made the openly licensed sample photographs and videos on this website, and under which licence.
Credits.title: Photo and video credits
Credits.intro: The photographs and videos on this website are openly licensed samples, shown until CHEF SIS's own are ready. They are not CHEF SIS's work.
Credits.changes: Photographs were resized for the web; videos were shortened, cropped, resized and silenced. Nothing else was changed.
